items.source: parameterIndex - the index of the parameter in the constructor or method that declares the parameter
items.translation: parameterIndex - 声明该参数的构造函数或方法中参数的索引

items.source: Returns true if the supplied parameter is annotated or meta-annotated with @Autowired, @Qualifier, or @Value.
items.translation: 如果提供的参数被标注或元标注了@Autowired、@Qualifier或@Value，则返回true。

items.source: Provides comprehensive autowiring support for individual method parameters on par with Spring's dependency injection facilities for autowired fields and methods, including support for @Autowired, @Qualifier, and @Value with support for property placeholders and SpEL expressions in @Value declarations.
items.translation: 为单个方法参数提供全面的自动装配支持，其功能与 Spring 针对自动装配字段和方法的依赖注入设施相当，包括对 `@Autowired`、`@Qualifier` 以及 `@Value` 的支持，后者支持属性占位符和 `@Value` 声明中的 SpEL 表达式。

items.source: The dependency is required unless the parameter is annotated or meta-annotated with @Autowired with the required flag set to false.
items.translation: 除非该参数被标注或元标注了带有 `required` 标志设置为 `false` 的 @Autowired，否则需要此依赖。

items.source: Note that resolveDependency(Parameter, int, Class, AutowireCapableBeanFactory) may still be able to resolve the dependency for the supplied parameter even if this method returns false.
items.translation: 注意，即使此方法返回 `false`，resolveDependency(Parameter, int, Class, AutowireCapableBeanFactory) 仍可能为提供的参数解析依赖。

items.source: If an explicit qualifier is not declared, the name of the parameter will be used as the qualifier for resolving ambiguities.
items.translation: 如果未声明显式的限定符，则参数的名称将用作解析歧义的限定符。

items.source: Determine if the supplied Parameter can potentially be autowired from an AutowireCapableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 确定提供的Parameter是否可以从AutowireCapableBeanFactorypotentially进行自动装配。

items.source: Resolve the dependency for the supplied Parameter from the supplied AutowireCapableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 解析所供应的 Parameter 对从所供应的 AutowireCapableBeanFactory 的依赖。

items.source: beanFactory - the AutowireCapableBeanFactory from which to resolve the dependency (must not be null)
items.translation: beanFactory - 用于解析依赖的 AutowireCapableBeanFactory（不能为 null）

items.source: parameter - the parameter whose dependency should be autowired (must not be null)
items.translation: parameter - 需要自动注入依赖的参数（不能为 null）

items.source: parameter - the parameter whose dependency should be resolved (must not be null)
items.translation: parameter - 需要解析其依赖的参数（不能为null）

items.source: containingClass - the concrete class that contains the parameter; this may differ from the class that declares the parameter in that it may be a subclass thereof, potentially substituting type variables (must not be null)
items.translation: containingClass - 包含该参数的具体类；此值可能与声明该参数的类不同，因为它可能是其子类，并可能替换了类型变量（不能为 null）

items.source: BeansException - if dependency resolution failed
items.translation: BeansException - 如果依赖解析失败

items.source:
Public delegate for resolving autowirable parameters on externally managed
constructors and methods.
items.translation: 用于解析外部管理的构造函数和方法上的自动注入参数的公共委托。

items.source: the resolved object, or null if none found
items.translation: 已解析的对象，或者如果未找到则为null
